lines: Toofaan ba-dil hai har koi, dildaar dekhna
couplets.en: Look, my love, every heart holds a storm.

lines: Gul ho na jaaye mishal-e-rukhsaar dekhna
couplets.en: Take care the flame in your cheek does not go out.

lines: Toofaan ba-dil hai har koi, dildaar dekhna
couplets.en: Look, my love, every heart holds a storm.
See what devotion draws the travelers toward the beloved.

lines: Sar dekhna, na sang, na deewaar dekhna
couplets.en: Look at their heads and let the stones and walls pass from sight.
See how few buyers remain in the lane of cruelty.

lines: Hum aa gaye to garmi-e-baazaar dekhna
couplets.en: Once we arrive, watch the marketplace come alive.
